summary: The legal array length is capped at 100 elements, which is too small for a stable runtime-scaling distinction between hash membership and repeated linear membership checks.

workload_bound.source_constraint: 1 <= n == nums.length <= 100, with every element between -100 and 100

replacement_checks.evidence: The accepted implementation scans at most 100 values to compute the sum and build a set, then skips at most n distinct present candidates, establishing O(n) expected time over the complete legal workload bound.

The certificate regression checks all 37,448 arrays over values -3 through 4 at lengths 1 through 5, then checks 5,000 deterministic legal arrays spanning every length through 100 and explicit extrema against an exact rational oracle.
